[

Research Models and Services

Support your basic research with help from the leading global supplier of laboratory animal models
and services.

][17][

Human Immune and Stem Cells

The leading developers of cutting-edge cell therapies and basic research trust us as their cell
sourcing provider.

][18][

Genetically Engineered Animals and Services

Genetically Engineered Animal Models and Services (GEMS) team helps you select, customize, and
maintain the right mice for your research. Services for genetically engineered animals include mouse
and rat model creation, breeding, genotyping, and mouse embryo and sperm cryopreservation.

][19]
[Discover the Offerings][20]
[

Integrated Drug Discovery

Reduce time to clinic by up to a year with an integrated drug discovery approach in which target
discovery, hit id, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, safety, and toxicology are all managed by the
same project team.

][21][

Discovery Pharmacology Studies

*In vitro* to *in vivo* translation is difficult, costly, and often fails. Advance your discovery
research with our translationally focused approach across a range of therapeutic areas including
oncology, neuroscience, and immunology.

][22][

Antibody Discovery Services

Antibody discovery services designed with your IND in mind. Comprehensive solutions, tailored to
your unique vision for your next antibody therapeutic.

][23]
[Learn What’s Possible][24]
[

Non-GLP Integrated Toxicology

Two primary study offerings are available for non-GLP toxicology studies for lead optimization and
preclinical development.

][25][

IND-enabling Programs

Successfully initiate and complete your IND-enabling program while meeting regulatory expectations
with our unique range of IND-enabling studies.

][26][

Carcinogenicity Studies

Our carcinogenicity studies include expert support in project design, model selection, and *in vivo*
and *ex vivo* data for final submission.

][27]
[Find Out More][28]
[

Biologics Testing Solutions

Our tailored global testing and manufacturing services support clients throughout the biologic
development cycle, from discovery through preclinical and clinical studies to marketed product
release.

][29][

Biologics Contract Manufacturing

Accelerate the development of your biopharmaceutical from concept to cure with our CGMP compliant
biologics contract manufacturing services. 

][30][

Rightsource^{SM} – Biologics Insourcing Solutions

A flexible testing platform that can be deployed where and when you need it, whether it’s located at
your facility, one of our satellite labs, or even within the walls of the many Charles River
facilities itself.

][31]
[Get the Details][32]
[

Cell and Gene CDMO Solutions

Fastrack your cell and gene development and manufacturing with our end-to-end scalable solutions
from early stage-research and testing through commercial release.

][33][

Biologics Testing and Manufacturing Solutions

Navigate seamlessly throughout the biologic development cycle, from early concept to market-ready
with our tailored, CGMP global testing and manufacturing solutions.

][34][

Microbiology Quality Control Solutions

Elevate your contamination control strategy and accelerate production with confidence. Our rapid,
accurate, and compliant microbial testing solutions optimize your QC workflow.

][35]
[Meet the Experts][36]
[

One Step Manufacturing

One Step by Charles River is a comprehensive, tailored suite of CRO drug discovery and development
services in target discovery, lead optimization, development chemistry, GMP, drug product
development and CMC strategy.

][37][

Fast Lane

Expedite your investigational new drug (IND) application with Fast Lane Paradigm. Learn how to
reduce white space between studies and accelerate time to clinic for you INDs.

][38][

IND-Enabling Studies Toolbox

Charles River can conduct an investigational new drug (IND) study from start to finish, and offers
stand-alone studies needed for IND-enabling submissions. Our IND experts have expertise in all major
therapeutic areas, including medical devices and gene and cell therapies.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]

[Shop Now][245]

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

strategic growth platforms.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# Ambiotis is the first Contract Research Organization (CRO) worldwide working on the active
# resolution of inflammation

## THE NEW APPROACH TO INFLAMMATION 

 

Perception of inflammation has changed: chronicity is not only a perpetual repetition of acute
inflammation but is resulting from an inability to solve the inflammatory disorder.

Pioneer in the field of inflammation resolution, Ambiotis has now acquired 10 years of experience
and built a strong expertise in both cell/animal models and analytical measurement. This combination

Telemedicine improves accessibility, convenience, and clinical outcomes, making quality care more
efficient and patient-centric.

reliability. Pathology, the study of diseases—its causes, mechanisms, and impact on the body—is
vital for accurate diagnosis, effective treatment, and disease prevention. By modernizing pathology
through innovation and efficiency, Clinicwala empowers healthcare providers to deliver faster, more
accurate medical decisions and improved patient outcomes.

records anytime, anywhere through our user-friendly application. A simple mobile number login
followed by a secure OTP verification grants instant access to the complete health profile. EHRs
enhance accuracy, accessibility, and continuity of care, allowing seamless sharing of patient data
among healthcare professionals. They also enable better monitoring of health outcomes over time,
making diagnosis and treatment more informed, efficient, and personalized.

insights and personalized nutritional guidance. Often overlooked, diet consultation plays a crucial
role in the treatment and recovery process—poor dietary habits can significantly impact health
outcomes. Our platform enables collaboration with experienced dietitians and nutritionists to create
customized meal plans tailored to an individual’s health conditions, goals, and lifestyle. Where
needed, the plan may include targeted supplements or nutritional interventions to enhance overall
well-being. By integrating diet into the core of healthcare, we help patients take proactive steps
toward better health, disease management, and improved quality of life.

expert medical attention. A referral program is a vital system where healthcare providers refer
patients to specialists or advanced care centers for more comprehensive treatment. By connecting
patients with the right experts at the right time, the program helps improve treatment outcomes,
enhances continuity of care, and ensures that no one is deprived of quality healthcare due to
geographic limitations.

[Healthcare Program][104]

Clinicwala offers a suite of intelligent software tools designed to streamline healthcare delivery

clinical decision-making, and improves overall care quality. By simplifying routine tasks and
organizing patient data efficiently, doctors can focus more on patient care and deliver timely,

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

into a single forecast you can act on.

  Predictions

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

04 — The cost
Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

[Victor Huberson]

Victor Huberson

Investor at Partech

01.

## Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Extract custom insights, like buyer lists or valuation sentiment, via MCP or the native AI chatbot.
Trained directly on our dataset.

[Connect to MCP][10]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Connect to Claude and other AI tools]
02.

## Investment-Grade Valuation Data

You can trust the numbers. Our public comps are powered by FactSet and Morningstar, while deal data
is sourced through a proprietary investment banking research. Benchmark 50+ various metrics like
EV/NTM revenue, EV/Gross Profit, rule of 40, Bessemer's rule of X, revenue per employee, or R&D to
sales ratio.

[See more on data][11]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Investment-Grade Valuation Data]
03.

## Sector Classification Built For Digital Age

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,
it's just incredibly easy to focus on metrics that matter the most.

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]
04.

## Automate Valuation Workflows With API

Use our white-label API to seamlessly integrate Multiples data within your existing Sheets or Excel
workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper
(and faster!) than legacy data providers.

[See API documentation][13]

With the most comprehensive tech-first company taxonomy I've seen for public markets, Multiples.vc
allowed us to bring the data to life for the State of European Tech Report readers.

[Hanna-Stina Sonts]

Hanna-Stina Sonts

VP at Atomico

[Automate Valuation Workflows With API]

## Finding Valuation Multiples
## Doesn't Need To Be Painful

Our mission: to deliver institutional-quality valuation data through a modern UI at a fraction of
the cost of major providers.

### AI Analyst

Native AI copilot continously trained on our dataset, so you can extract custom insights in seconds.

### Consensus Estimates

Access metrics like NTM Revenue or 2027E EBITDA, powered by FactSet, harmonized by us.

### Verified Deal Data

Get M&A and VC round valuation data with over 27% more deal multiples compared to MergerMarket.

### Historical Time Series Data

Track valuation trends with 10 years of monthly historical data across all public companies.

### Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Use [MCP][14] to extract insights from our dataset without leaving Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
tools.

### Valuations, Automated

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our
[API][15].

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

[ Show all tests ][51]
[Home Page Banner Image]

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]
[How it Works Image 1]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

[How it Works Image 2]

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

[View Resources][53]

### Explore your treatment options

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

[View Treatments][54]

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Latest News

May 16, 2022

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.
